#    and "b 3F*", "a 3D*" and "b 3D*". The a-members sit below 59232
#    and the b-members above it. The letter is doing the job of the
#    LIMIT ASSIGNMENT, not of term disambiguation. **
#    ** THAT IS A NINTH USE OF THE LETTER PREFIX AND THE ONLY ONE WHERE
#       IT ENCODES WHICH PARENT THE SERIES CONVERGES ON. Recorded. **
